_note: ARM-01: the player's arms on the blasters and the sword. A code-built placeholder (a mitten glove, a cuff and a sleeve): the look is [Paul]'s to redraw. Each hand sits on a grip point and its sleeve runs to an elbow point off the screen. Which part a blaster's support hand rides is on the blaster, in data/blasters.json `viewmodel.support`; a blaster with `hands: 1` has no support hand.

look._note: Metres. colors are placeholders for [Paul]. palm is the fist's width, height and depth (an ellipsoid round the grip, so the grip passes through it); the thumb lies along the top of the fist on the inner side; the cuff is the glove's band at the wrist; the sleeve runs from wristRadius at the cuff to elbowRadius at the elbow.

trigger._note: Where the trigger hand's fist sits when a blaster does not say (`viewmodel.trigger`), in model space: the model's origin is the trigger-hand grip (PLAN 5.2).

elbow._note: Where each sleeve runs to, in the blaster's model space (so the arms kick, tilt and dip with it): right is the trigger arm, left the support arm. Both are behind the camera, so the sleeves leave the bottom of the view.

sword._note: The sword hand's elbow, measured from the sword's own placement (data/melee.json `look.position`), in the camera's axes.
